7564.title: Command metadata can exceed menu width
7564.rootCauseOneLine: An unbounded non-shrinking argument hint consumes the command row and collapses its name.
7564.proposedFix: Bound command names and hints, preserve name width, and ellipsize shrinking hints.
7564.caveats: Component-level Chromium reproduction; no full-provider or Safari run. Test sources and exact results are inline in the report.
